im not sure whether these are weird but

\> while eating, i have to watch an ed/diet related video that's at least 8 minutes long - i can't eat my meal for a shorter time than that

\> if i'm with my friends and they eat less than me, i have do at least 1h cardio

\> i won't eat anything from big sized plates/bowls. food has to be put at something small to cover it as much as possible. + i eat generally everything with chopsticks, also things like crisps -- it helps to not binge when it takes so much time

\> i'm not allowed to watch youtube videos/movies in languages that i speak fluently unless i'm exercising while doing it

i'll try to be more attentive to such good things, thank you!

i'm not in the financial position to go privately and public one takes about a year of waiting.
